      "akn4eu_heading": "Follow-up by competent authorities",
      "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER V",
        "Section II"
      ],
      "text": "The Lead Overseer may, upon request, provide further clarifications on the recommendations issued to guide the competent authorities on the follow-up measures.",
      "outbound_relations": [
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art42-Para11__article-Art35-Para1__depends_on",
          "source": "article-Art42-Para11",
          "target": "article-Art35-Para1",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "depends_on",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "Article 42(11) permits clarifications on recommendations issued to guide competent-authority follow-up; that clarification power presupposes the recommendation power established in Article 35(1)(d).",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art42-Para11",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art35-Para1"
        }
      ],
      "inbound_relations": [],
      "akn4eu_source_paragraphs": [
        {
          "sequence": 1,
          "text": "The Lead Overseer may, upon request, provide further clarifications on the recommendations issued to guide the competent authorities on the follow-up measures.",
          "source_line_start": 7816,
          "source_line_end": 7816
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_article_type_uri": "http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/resource-type/ART",
      "canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art42-Para11",
      "text_sha256": "e339f3c581d45618bbb789d353c19fc8be23f39d814d3f95311aaaf716237154"
    },
    {
      "id": "article-Art43-Para1",
      "type": "article_paragraph",
      "article_number": 43,
      "paragraph_number": "1",
      "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
      "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
      "akn4eu_heading": "Oversight fees",
      "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER V",
        "Section II"
      ],
      "text": "The Lead Overseer shall, in accordance with the delegated act referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article, charge critical ICT third-party service providers fees that fully cover the Lead Overseer’s necessary expenditure in relation to the conduct of oversight tasks pursuant to this Regulation, including the reimbursement of any costs which may be incurred as a result of work carried out by the joint examination team referred to in Article 40, as well as the costs of advice provided by the independent experts as referred to in Article 32(4), second subparagraph, in relation to matters falling under the remit of direct oversight activities. The amount of a fee charged to a critical ICT third-party service provider shall cover all costs derived from the execution of the duties set out in this Section and shall be proportionate to its turnover.",
      "outbound_relations": [
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art43-Para1__article-Art32-Para4__references",
          "source": "article-Art43-Para1",
          "target": "article-Art32-Para4",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "references",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "article-Art43-Para1 expressly includes the cost of advice from independent experts whose use by the Oversight Forum is authorised in article-Art32-Para4.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art43-Para1",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art32-Para4"
        },
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art43-Para1__article-Art40-Para1__references",
          "source": "article-Art43-Para1",
          "target": "article-Art40-Para1",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "references",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "Fee-funded expenditure in article-Art43-Para1 expressly includes work by the joint examination team established for oversight activities under article-Art40-Para1.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art43-Para1",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art40-Para1"
        },
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art43-Para1__article-Art43-Para2__depends_on",
          "source": "article-Art43-Para1",
          "target": "article-Art43-Para2",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "depends_on",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "The fee charge and calculation in article-Art43-Para1 depend expressly on the amount and payment method fixed by the delegated act authorised in article-Art43-Para2.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art43-Para1",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art43-Para2"
        }
      ],
      "inbound_relations": [
        {
          "edge_id": "recital-96__article-Art43-Para1__provides_guidance_for",
          "source": "recital-96",
          "target": "article-Art43-Para1",
          "source_type": "recital",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "provides_guidance_for",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "recital-96 explains that direct oversight expenditure should be fee-funded while distinguishing separately financed ESA system development; article-Art43-Para1 limits provider fees to necessary oversight costs.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/recital-96",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art43-Para1"
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_source_paragraphs": [

          "text": "The Lead Overseer shall, in accordance with the delegated act referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article, charge critical ICT third-party service providers fees that fully cover the Lead Overseer’s necessary expenditure in relation to the conduct of oversight tasks pursuant to this Regulation, including the reimbursement of any costs which may be incurred as a result of work carried out by the joint examination team referred to in Article 40, as well as the costs of advice provided by the independent experts as referred to in Article 32(4), second subparagraph, in relation to matters falling under the remit of direct oversight activities.",

    {
      "id": "article-Art44-Para1",
      "type": "article_paragraph",
      "article_number": 44,
      "paragraph_number": "1",
      "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
      "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
      "akn4eu_heading": "International cooperation",
      "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER V",
        "Section II"
      ],
      "text": "Without prejudice to Article 36, EBA, ESMA and EIOPA may, in accordance with Article 33 of Regulations (EU) No 1093/2010, (EU) No 1095/2010 and (EU) No 1094/2010, respectively, conclude administrative arrangements with third-country regulatory and supervisory authorities to foster international cooperation on ICT third-party risk across different financial sectors, in particular by developing best practices for the review of ICT risk management practices and controls, mitigation measures and incident responses.",
      "outbound_relations": [
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art44-Para1__article-Art36-Para2__qualifies",
          "source": "article-Art44-Para1",
          "target": "article-Art36-Para2",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "qualifies",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "article-Art44-Para1 operates without prejudice to the inspection-specific third-country cooperation arrangements in article-Art36-Para2, preserving that narrower regime while authorising broader best-practice arrangements.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art44-Para1",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art36-Para2"
        }
      ],
      "inbound_relations": [
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art44-Para2__article-Art44-Para1__depends_on",
          "source": "article-Art44-Para2",
          "target": "article-Art44-Para1",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "depends_on",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "The five-year confidential report in article-Art44-Para2 depends on discussions with the third-country authorities participating in arrangements under article-Art44-Para1.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art44-Para2",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art44-Para1"
        },
        {
          "edge_id": "recital-94__article-Art44-Para1__concretizes",
          "source": "recital-94",
          "target": "article-Art44-Para1",
          "source_type": "recital",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "concretizes",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "recital-94 calls for third-country cooperation on ICT third-party risk controls, mitigation and incident response; article-Art44-Para1 authorises the ESAs to conclude arrangements for those best-practice objectives.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/recital-94",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art44-Para1"
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_source_paragraphs": [
        {
          "sequence": 1,
          "text": "Without prejudice to Article 36, EBA, ESMA and EIOPA may, in accordance with Article 33 of Regulations (EU) No 1093/2010, (EU) No 1095/2010 and (EU) No 1094/2010, respectively, conclude administrative arrangements with third-country regulatory and supervisory authorities to foster international cooperation on ICT third-party risk across different financial sectors, in particular by developing best practices for the review of ICT risk management practices and controls, mitigation measures and incident responses.",
          "source_line_start": 7838,
          "source_line_end": 7838
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_article_type_uri": "http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/resource-type/ART",
      "canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art44-Para1",
      "text_sha256": "aa9a52550bced9aa23eb8cbf2990dcece9e47f82b237ec211ffe498d54f9da0b"
    },
    {
      "id": "article-Art44-Para2",
      "type": "article_paragraph",
      "article_number": 44,
      "paragraph_number": "2",
      "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
      "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
      "akn4eu_heading": "International cooperation",
      "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER V",
        "Section II"
      ],
      "text": "The ESAs shall, through the Joint Committee, submit every five years a joint confidential report to the European Parliament, to the Council and to the Commission, summarising the findings of relevant discussions held with the third countries’ authorities referred to in paragraph 1, focusing on the evolution of ICT third-party risk and the implications for financial stability, market integrity, investor protection and the functioning of the internal market.",
      "outbound_relations": [

          "edge_id": "article-Art44-Para2__article-Art44-Para1__depends_on",
          "source": "article-Art44-Para2",
          "target": "article-Art44-Para1",

          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "depends_on",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "The five-year confidential report in article-Art44-Para2 depends on discussions with the third-country authorities participating in arrangements under article-Art44-Para1.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art44-Para2",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art44-Para1"
        }
      ],
      "inbound_relations": [],
      "akn4eu_source_paragraphs": [
        {
          "sequence": 1,
          "text": "The ESAs shall, through the Joint Committee, submit every five years a joint confidential report to the European Parliament, to the Council and to the Commission, summarising the findings of relevant discussions held with the third countries’ authorities referred to in paragraph 1, focusing on the evolution of ICT third-party risk and the implications for financial stability, market integrity, investor protection and the functioning of the internal market.",

    {
      "id": "article-Art45-Para1",
      "type": "article_paragraph",
      "article_number": 45,
      "paragraph_number": "1",
      "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
      "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
      "akn4eu_heading": "Information-sharing arrangements on cyber threat information and intelligence",
      "akn4eu_sub_units": [
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(a)",
          "text": "aims to enhance the digital operational resilience of financial entities, in particular through raising awareness in relation to cyber threats, limiting or impeding the cyber threats’ ability to spread, supporting defence capabilities, threat detection techniques, mitigation strategies or response and recovery stages;",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(a)",
          "source_line_start": 7870,
          "source_line_end": 7873
        },
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(b)",
          "text": "takes places within trusted communities of financial entities;",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(b)",
          "source_line_start": 7884,
          "source_line_end": 7887
        },
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(c)",
          "text": "is implemented through information-sharing arrangements that protect the potentially sensitive nature of the information shared, and that are governed by rules of conduct in full respect of business confidentiality, protection of personal data in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 and guidelines on competition policy.",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(c)",
          "source_line_start": 7898,
          "source_line_end": 7901
        }
      ],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER VI"
      ],
      "text": "Financial entities may exchange amongst themselves cyber threat information and intelligence, including indicators of compromise, tactics, techniques, and procedures, cyber security alerts and configuration tools, to the extent that such information and intelligence sharing: (a) aims to enhance the digital operational resilience of financial entities, in particular through raising awareness in relation to cyber threats, limiting or impeding the cyber threats’ ability to spread, supporting defence capabilities, threat detection techniques, mitigation strategies or response and recovery stages; (b) takes places within trusted communities of financial entities; (c) is implemented through information-sharing arrangements that protect the potentially sensitive nature of the information shared, and that are governed by rules of conduct in full respect of business confidentiality, protection of personal data in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 and guidelines on competition policy.",
      "outbound_relations": [],
      "inbound_relations": [
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art45-Para2__article-Art45-Para1__depends_on",
          "source": "article-Art45-Para2",
          "target": "article-Art45-Para1",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "depends_on",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "Article 45(2) depends on paragraph 1 because it specifies participation, authority and provider involvement, and operational elements for the information-sharing arrangements whose sensitive information paragraph 1(c) requires to be protected.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art45-Para2",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art45-Para1"
        },
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art45-Para3__article-Art45-Para1__references",
          "source": "article-Art45-Para3",
          "target": "article-Art45-Para1",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "references",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "Article 45(3) expressly requires notice of participation in the arrangements referred to in paragraph 1; Article 45(1) is therefore the direct referenced definition of those arrangements.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art45-Para3",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art45-Para1"
        },
        {

          "source_type": "recital",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "provides_guidance_for",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "recital-32: The prevention, containment and recovery benefits explain the permitted intelligence exchange. Target: article-Art45-Para1.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/recital-32",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art45-Para1"
        },

          "target": "article-Art45-Para1",
          "source_type": "recital",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "provides_guidance_for",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "recital-33: Uncertainty over shareable information explains the bounded exchange permission. Target: article-Art45-Para1.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/recital-33",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art45-Para1"
        },
        {
          "edge_id": "recital-34__article-Art45-Para1__concretizes",

          "target": "article-Art45-Para1",
          "source_type": "recital",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "concretizes",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "recital-34: Voluntary trusted sharing and competition, confidentiality and data-protection safeguards are codified here. Target: article-Art45-Para1.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/recital-34",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art45-Para1"
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_source_paragraphs": [
        {
          "sequence": 1,
          "text": "Financial entities may exchange amongst themselves cyber threat information and intelligence, including indicators of compromise, tactics, techniques, and procedures, cyber security alerts and configuration tools, to the extent that such information and intelligence sharing:",
          "source_line_start": 7863,
          "source_line_end": 7863
        }

      "akn4eu_article_type_uri": "http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/resource-type/ART",
      "canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art45-Para1",
      "text_sha256": "2ba9addbe5ce363eebf301b33bf7e06d19f24d2a7a33d39adafbde8151b03077"
    },
    {
      "id": "article-Art45-Para2",
      "type": "article_paragraph",
      "article_number": 45,
      "paragraph_number": "2",
      "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
      "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
      "akn4eu_heading": "Information-sharing arrangements on cyber threat information and intelligence",
      "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER VI"
      ],
      "text": "For the purpose of paragraph 1, point (c), the information-sharing arrangements shall define the conditions for participation and, where appropriate, shall set out the details on the involvement of public authorities and the capacity in which they may be associated to the information-sharing arrangements, on the involvement of ICT third-party service providers, and on operational elements, including the use of dedicated IT platforms.",
      "outbound_relations": [
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art45-Para2__article-Art45-Para1__depends_on",
          "source": "article-Art45-Para2",
          "target": "article-Art45-Para1",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "depends_on",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "Article 45(2) depends on paragraph 1 because it specifies participation, authority and provider involvement, and operational elements for the information-sharing arrangements whose sensitive information paragraph 1(c) requires to be protected.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art45-Para2",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art45-Para1"
        }
      ],
      "inbound_relations": [
        {
          "edge_id": "recital-33__article-Art45-Para2__concretizes",
          "source": "recital-33",
          "target": "article-Art45-Para2",
          "source_type": "recital",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "concretizes",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "recital-33: Uncertainty over public-authority involvement is addressed by participation and operational rules. Target: article-Art45-Para2.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/recital-33",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art45-Para2"
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_source_paragraphs": [
        {
          "sequence": 1,
          "text": "For the purpose of paragraph 1, point (c), the information-sharing arrangements shall define the conditions for participation and, where appropriate, shall set out the details on the involvement of public authorities and the capacity in which they may be associated to the information-sharing arrangements, on the involvement of ICT third-party service providers, and on operational elements, including the use of dedicated IT platforms.",
          "source_line_start": 7908,
          "source_line_end": 7908
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_article_type_uri": "http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/resource-type/ART",
      "canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art45-Para2",
      "text_sha256": "8c88fb3cf38622d5c550a1a56b89c09372b618ae5ca10eec9f413c474c5668a3"

    {
      "id": "article-Art45-Para3",
      "type": "article_paragraph",

      "akn4eu_heading": "Information-sharing arrangements on cyber threat information and intelligence",
      "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER VI"
      ],
      "text": "Financial entities shall notify competent authorities of their participation in the information-sharing arrangements referred to in paragraph 1, upon validation of their membership, or, as applicable, of the cessation of their membership, once it takes effect.",
      "outbound_relations": [
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art45-Para3__article-Art45-Para1__references",
          "source": "article-Art45-Para3",
          "target": "article-Art45-Para1",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "references",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "Article 45(3) expressly requires notice of participation in the arrangements referred to in paragraph 1; Article 45(1) is therefore the direct referenced definition of those arrangements.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art45-Para3",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art45-Para1"
        }
      ],
      "inbound_relations": [],
      "akn4eu_source_paragraphs": [
        {
          "sequence": 1,
          "text": "Financial entities shall notify competent authorities of their participation in the information-sharing arrangements referred to in paragraph 1, upon validation of their membership, or, as applicable, of the cessation of their membership, once it takes effect.",
          "source_line_start": 7911,
          "source_line_end": 7911
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_article_type_uri": "http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/resource-type/ART",

    {
      "id": "article-Art46-Para1",
      "type": "article_paragraph",
      "article_number": 46,
      "paragraph_number": "1",
      "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "single",
      "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
      "akn4eu_heading": "Competent authorities",
      "akn4eu_sub_units": [
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(a)",
          "text": "for credit institutions and for institutions exempted pursuant to Directive 2013/36/EU, the competent authority designated in accordance with Article 4 of that Directive, and for credit institutions classified as significant in accordance with Article 6(4) of Regulation (EU) No 1024/2013, the ECB in accordance with the powers and tasks conferred by that Regulation;",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(a)",
          "source_line_start": 7938,
          "source_line_end": 7941
        },
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(b)",
          "text": "for payment institutions, including payment institutions exempted pursuant to Directive (EU) 2015/2366, electronic money institutions, including those exempted pursuant to Directive 2009/110/EC, and account information service providers as referred to in Article 33(1) of Directive (EU) 2015/2366, the competent authority designated in accordance with Article 22 of Directive (EU) 2015/2366;",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(b)",
          "source_line_start": 7952,
          "source_line_end": 7955
        },
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(c)",
          "text": "for investment firms, the competent authority designated in accordance with Article 4 of Directive (EU) 2019/2034 of the European Parliament and of the Council (38);",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(c)",
          "source_line_start": 7966,
          "source_line_end": 7970
        },
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(d)",
          "text": "for crypto-asset service providers as authorised under the Regulation on markets in crypto-assets and issuers of asset-referenced tokens, the competent authority designated in accordance with the relevant provision of that Regulation;",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(d)",
          "source_line_start": 7981,
          "source_line_end": 7984
        },
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(e)",
          "text": "for central securities depositories, the competent authority designated in accordance with Article 11 of Regulation (EU) No 909/2014;",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(e)",
          "source_line_start": 7995,
          "source_line_end": 7998
        },
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(f)",
          "text": "for central counterparties, the competent authority designated in accordance with Article 22 of Regulation (EU) No 648/2012;",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(f)",
          "source_line_start": 8009,
          "source_line_end": 8012
        },
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(g)",
          "text": "for trading venues and data reporting service providers, the competent authority designated in accordance with Article 67 of Directive 2014/65/EU, and the competent authority as defined in Article 2(1), point (18), of Regulation (EU) No 600/2014;",
          "depth": 1,

      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER VII"
      ],
      "text": "Without prejudice to the provisions on the Oversight Framework for critical ICT third-party service providers referred to in Chapter V, Section II, of this Regulation, compliance with this Regulation shall be ensured by the following competent authorities in accordance with the powers granted by the respective legal acts: (a) for credit institutions and for institutions exempted pursuant to Directive 2013/36/EU, the competent authority designated in accordance with Article 4 of that Directive, and for credit institutions classified as significant in accordance with Article 6(4) of Regulation (EU) No 1024/2013, the ECB in accordance with the powers and tasks conferred by that Regulation; (b) for payment institutions, including payment institutions exempted pursuant to Directive (EU) 2015/2366, electronic money institutions, including those exempted pursuant to Directive 2009/110/EC, and account information service providers as referred to in Article 33(1) of Directive (EU) 2015/2366, the competent authority designated in accordance with Article 22 of Directive (EU) 2015/2366; (c) for investment firms, the competent authority designated in accordance with Article 4 of Directive (EU) 2019/2034 of the European Parliament and of the Council ( 38 ) ; (d) for crypto-asset service providers as authorised under the Regulation on markets in crypto-assets and issuers of asset-referenced tokens, the competent authority designated in accordance with the relevant provision of that Regulation; (e) for central securities depositories, the competent authority designated in accordance with Article 11 of Regulation (EU) No 909/2014; (f) for central counterparties, the competent authority designated in accordance with Article 22 of Regulation (EU) No 648/2012; (g) for trading venues and data reporting service providers, the competent authority designated in accordance with Article 67 of Directive 2014/65/EU, and the competent authority as defined in Article 2(1), point (18), of Regulation (EU) No 600/2014; (h) for trade repositories, the competent authority designated in accordance with Article 22 of Regulation (EU) No 648/2012; (i) for managers of alternative investment funds, the competent authority designated in accordance with Article 44 of Directive 2011/61/EU; (j) for management companies, the competent authority designated in accordance with Article 97 of Directive 2009/65/EC; (k) for insurance and reinsurance undertakings, the competent authority designated in accordance with Article 30 of Directive 2009/138/EC; (l) for insurance intermediaries, reinsurance intermediaries and ancillary insurance intermediaries, the competent authority designated in accordance with Article 12 of Directive (EU) 2016/97; (m) for institutions for occupational retirement provision, the competent authority designated in accordance with Article 47 of Directive (EU) 2016/2341; (n) for credit rating agencies, the competent authority designated in accordance with Article 21 of Regulation (EC) No 1060/2009; (o) for administrators of critical benchmarks, the competent authority designated in accordance with Articles 40 and 41 of Regulation (EU) 2016/1011; (p) for crowdfunding service providers, the competent authority designated in accordance with Article 29 of Regulation (EU) 2020/1503; (q) for securitisation repositories, the competent authority designated in accordance with Articles 10 and 14(1) of Regulation (EU) 2017/2402.",
      "outbound_relations": [],
      "inbound_relations": [

    {
      "id": "article-Art47-Para1",
      "type": "article_paragraph",
      "article_number": 47,

      "akn4eu_heading": "Cooperation with structures and authorities established by Directive (EU) 2022/2555",
      "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER VII"
      ],
      "text": "To foster cooperation and enable supervisory exchanges between the competent authorities designated under this Regulation and the Cooperation Group established by Article 14 of Directive (EU) 2022/2555, the ESAs and the competent authorities may participate in the activities of the Cooperation Group for matters that concern their supervisory activities in relation to financial entities. The ESAs and the competent authorities may request to be invited to participate in the activities of the Cooperation Group for matters in relation to essential or important entities subject to Directive (EU) 2022/2555 that have also been designated as critical ICT third-party service providers pursuant to Article 31 of this Regulation.",
      "outbound_relations": [

          "target": "article-Art31-Para1",

          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "references",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "article-Art47-Para1 conditions enhanced NIS2 Cooperation Group participation on providers designated as critical pursuant to Article 31, with article-Art31-Para1 supplying the designation decision.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art47-Para1",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art31-Para1"
        }
      ],

          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/recital-18",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art47-Para1"
        }
      ],

The ESAs and the competent authorities may request to be invited to participate in the activities of the Cooperation Group for matters in relation to essential or important entities subject to Directive (EU) 2022/2555 that have also been designated as critical ICT third-party service providers pursuant to Article 31 of this Regulation.",

    {
      "id": "article-Art47-Para4",
      "type": "article_paragraph",
      "article_number": 47,
      "paragraph_number": "4",
      "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
      "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
      "akn4eu_heading": "Cooperation with structures and authorities established by Directive (EU) 2022/2555",
      "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER VII"
      ],
      "text": "The arrangements referred to in paragraph 3 of this Article may, inter alia, specify the procedures for the coordination of supervisory and oversight activities in relation to essential or important entities subject to Directive (EU) 2022/2555 that have been designated as critical ICT third-party service providers pursuant to Article 31 of this Regulation, including for the conduct, in accordance with national law, of investigations and on-site inspections, as well as for mechanisms for the exchange of information between the competent authorities under this Regulation and the competent authorities designated or established in accordance with that Directive which includes access to information requested by the latter authorities.",
      "outbound_relations": [

          "source": "article-Art47-Para4",
          "target": "article-Art31-Para1",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "references",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "article-Art47-Para4 applies its coordinated oversight mechanisms to NIS2 entities designated as critical under Article 31, whose designation is effected by article-Art31-Para1.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art47-Para4",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art31-Para1"
        },
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art47-Para4__article-Art47-Para3__depends_on",
          "source": "article-Art47-Para4",
          "target": "article-Art47-Para3",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "depends_on",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "The coordination procedures and information-access mechanisms described in article-Art47-Para4 depend expressly on the cooperation arrangements authorised by article-Art47-Para3.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art47-Para4",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art47-Para3"
        }
      ],
      "inbound_relations": [],

    {

      "type": "article_paragraph",

      "paragraph_number": "2",

      "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER VII"
      ],
      "text": "Competent authorities and the Lead Overseer shall, in a timely manner, mutually exchange all relevant information concerning critical ICT third-party service providers which is necessary for them to carry out their respective duties under this Regulation, in particular in relation to identified risks, approaches and measures taken as part of the Lead Overseer’s oversight tasks.",

          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "depends_on",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "Article 48(2) operationalises the general cooperation duty in Article 48(1) by requiring competent authorities and the Lead Overseer to exchange, in a timely manner, provider-specific information on identified risks, approaches and oversight measures.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art48-Para2",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art48-Para1"
        }
      ],
      "inbound_relations": [

          "target": "article-Art48-Para2",

          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "concretizes",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "The necessary information exchange component of recital-97 is made specific for critical providers, identified risks and oversight measures by article-Art48-Para2.",

          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art48-Para2"
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_source_paragraphs": [

    {
      "id": "article-Art49-Para1",
      "type": "article_paragraph",
      "article_number": 49,
      "paragraph_number": "1",
      "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
      "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
      "akn4eu_heading": "Financial cross-sector exercises, communication and cooperation",
      "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER VII"
      ],
      "text": "The ESAs, through the Joint Committee and in collaboration with competent authorities, resolution authorities as referred to in Article 3 of Directive 2014/59/EU, the ECB, the Single Resolution Board as regards information relating to entities falling under the scope of Regulation (EU) No 806/2014, the ESRB and ENISA, as appropriate, may establish mechanisms to enable the sharing of effective practices across financial sectors to enhance situational awareness and identify common cyber vulnerabilities and risks across sectors. They may develop crisis management and contingency exercises involving cyber-attack scenarios with a view to developing communication channels and gradually enabling an effective coordinated response at Union level in the event of a major cross-border ICT-related incident or related threat having a systemic impact on the Union’s financial sector as a whole. Those exercises may, as appropriate, also test the financial sector’s dependencies on other economic sectors.",
      "outbound_relations": [],
      "inbound_relations": [],
      "akn4eu_source_paragraphs": [
        {
          "sequence": 1,
          "text": "The ESAs, through the Joint Committee and in collaboration with competent authorities, resolution authorities as referred to in Article 3 of Directive 2014/59/EU, the ECB, the Single Resolution Board as regards information relating to entities falling under the scope of Regulation (EU) No 806/2014, the ESRB and ENISA, as appropriate, may establish mechanisms to enable the sharing of effective practices across financial sectors to enhance situational awareness and identify common cyber vulnerabilities and risks across sectors.",
          "source_line_start": 8208,

        },

          "text": "They may develop crisis management and contingency exercises involving cyber-attack scenarios with a view to developing communication channels and gradually enabling an effective coordinated response at Union level in the event of a major cross-border ICT-related incident or related threat having a systemic impact on the Union’s financial sector as a whole.",
          "source_line_start": 8209,
          "source_line_end": 8209
        },
        {
          "sequence": 3,
          "text": "Those exercises may, as appropriate, also test the financial sector’s dependencies on other economic sectors.",
          "source_line_start": 8210,
          "source_line_end": 8210
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_article_type_uri": "http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/resource-type/ART",

    {
      "id": "article-Art49-Para2",
      "type": "article_paragraph",
      "article_number": 49,
      "paragraph_number": "2",
      "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
      "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
      "akn4eu_heading": "Financial cross-sector exercises, communication and cooperation",
      "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER VII"
      ],
      "text": "Competent authorities, ESAs and the ECB shall cooperate closely with each other and exchange information to carry out their duties pursuant to Articles 47 to 54.       "inbound_relations": [

          "relation": "concretizes",

          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/recital-97",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art49-Para2"
        }
      ],

    {

      "akn4eu_sub_units": [
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(a)",
          "text": "have access to any document or data held in any form that the competent authority considers relevant for the performance of its duties and receive or take a copy of it;",

          "source_line_start": 8232,

        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(b)",
          "text": "carry out on-site inspections or investigations, which shall include but shall not be limited to;",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(b)",
          "source_line_start": 8246,
          "source_line_end": 8249
        },
        {
          "type": "subpoint",
          "marker": "(i)",
          "text": "summoning representatives of the financial entities for oral or written explanations on facts or documents relating to the subject matter and purpose of the investigation and to record the answers;",

          "source_line_start": 8256,
          "source_line_end": 8259
        },
        {
          "type": "subpoint",
          "marker": "(ii)",
          "text": "interviewing any other natural or legal person who consents to be interviewed for the purpose of collecting information relating to the subject matter of an investigation;",
          "depth": 2,
          "parent_marker": "(b)",
          "path": "(b)(ii)",
          "source_line_start": 8270,
          "source_line_end": 8273
        },
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(c)",
          "text": "require corrective and remedial measures for breaches of the requirements of this Regulation.",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(c)",
          "source_line_start": 8288,
          "source_line_end": 8291
        }
      ],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER VII"
      ],
      "text": "The powers referred to in paragraph 1 shall include at least the following powers to: (a) have access to any document or data held in any form that the competent authority considers relevant for the performance of its duties and receive or take a copy of it; (b) carry out on-site inspections or investigations, which shall include but shall not be limited to; (i) summoning representatives of the financial entities for oral or written explanations on facts or documents relating to the subject matter and purpose of the investigation and to record the answers; (ii) interviewing any other natural or legal person who consents to be interviewed for the purpose of collecting information relating to the subject matter of an investigation; (c) require corrective and remedial measures for breaches of the requirements of this Regulation.",
      "outbound_relations": [
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art50-Para2__article-Art50-Para1__depends_on",

          "relation": "depends_on",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "The minimum document-access, investigation and remediation powers in article-Art50-Para2 are expressly included within the general supervisory, investigatory and sanctioning powers conferred by article-Art50-Para1.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art50-Para2",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art50-Para1"
        }
      ],
      "inbound_relations": [

          "target": "article-Art50-Para2",

          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "qualifies",

          "reasoning": "article-Art50-Para5 qualifies the corrective powers in article-Art50-Para2 point (c) by extending their possible application to responsible management-body members and other responsible individuals.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art50-Para5",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art50-Para2"
        },
        {

          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "depends_on",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "The reason-giving and appeal safeguards in article-Art50-Para6 attach expressly to remedial decisions imposed under article-Art50-Para2 point (c).",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art50-Para6",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art50-Para2"
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_source_paragraphs": [
        {
          "sequence": 1,
          "text": "The powers referred to in paragraph 1 shall include at least the following powers to:",

          "source_line_end": 8225
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_article_type_uri": "http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/resource-type/ART",
      "canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art50-Para2",
      "text_sha256": "7fab2e44381cc2ce38fc596351cc5e01a10b5663876b8407164cd4c41d9fe5c7"
    },
    {
      "id": "article-Art50-Para3",
      "type": "article_paragraph",
      "article_number": 50,
      "paragraph_number": "3",
      "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
      "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
      "akn4eu_heading": "Administrative penalties and remedial measures",
      "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER VII"
      ],
      "text": "Without prejudice to the right of Member States to impose criminal penalties in accordance with Article 52, Member States shall lay down rules establishing appropriate administrative penalties and remedial measures for breaches of this Regulation and shall ensure their effective implementation. Those penalties and measures shall be effective, proportionate and dissuasive.",
      "outbound_relations": [
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art50-Para3__article-Art52-Para1__references",
          "source": "article-Art50-Para3",
          "target": "article-Art52-Para1",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "references",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "The administrative-penalty duty in article-Art50-Para3 expressly preserves the Member-State option in article-Art52-Para1 where breaches are subject to national criminal penalties.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art50-Para3",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art52-Para1"
        }
      ],
      "inbound_relations": [],
      "akn4eu_source_paragraphs": [
        {
          "sequence": 1,
          "text": "Without prejudice to the right of Member States to impose criminal penalties in accordance with Article 52, Member States shall lay down rules establishing appropriate administrative penalties and remedial measures for breaches of this Regulation and shall ensure their effective implementation.",
          "source_line_start": 8298,
          "source_line_end": 8298
        },
        {
          "sequence": 2,
          "text": "Those penalties and measures shall be effective, proportionate and dissuasive.",
          "source_line_start": 8299,
          "source_line_end": 8299
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_article_type_uri": "http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/resource-type/ART",
      "canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art50-Para3",
      "text_sha256": "967f4e951994a9a25eae992469d1611f13c80312659aa1529f6d50bead6eaad2"
    },
    {
      "id": "article-Art50-Para4",
      "type": "article_paragraph",
      "article_number": 50,
      "paragraph_number": "4",
      "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
      "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
      "akn4eu_heading": "Administrative penalties and remedial measures",
      "akn4eu_sub_units": [
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(a)",
          "text": "issue an order requiring the natural or legal person to cease conduct that is in breach of this Regulation and to desist from a repetition of that conduct;",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(a)",
          "source_line_start": 8309,
          "source_line_end": 8312
        },
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(b)",
          "text": "require the temporary or permanent cessation of any practice or conduct that the competent authority considers to be contrary to the provisions of this Regulation and prevent repetition of that practice or conduct;",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(b)",
          "source_line_start": 8323,
          "source_line_end": 8326
        },
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(c)",
          "text": "adopt any type of measure, including of pecuniary nature, to ensure that financial entities continue to comply with legal requirements;",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(c)",
          "source_line_start": 8337,
          "source_line_end": 8340
        },
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(d)",
          "text": "require, insofar as permitted by national law, existing data traffic records held by a telecommunication operator, where there is a reasonable suspicion of a breach of this Regulation and where such records may be relevant to an investigation into breaches of this Regulation; and",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(d)",
          "source_line_start": 8351,
          "source_line_end": 8354
        },
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(e)",
          "text": "issue public notices, including public statements indicating the identity of the natural or legal person and the nature of the breach.",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(e)",
          "source_line_start": 8365,
          "source_line_end": 8368
        }
      ],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER VII"
      ],
      "text": "Member States shall confer on competent authorities the power to apply at least the following administrative penalties or remedial measures for breaches of this Regulation: (a) issue an order requiring the natural or legal person to cease conduct that is in breach of this Regulation and to desist from a repetition of that conduct; (b) require the temporary or permanent cessation of any practice or conduct that the competent authority considers to be contrary to the provisions of this Regulation and prevent repetition of that practice or conduct; (c) adopt any type of measure, including of pecuniary nature, to ensure that financial entities continue to comply with legal requirements; (d) require, insofar as permitted by national law, existing data traffic records held by a telecommunication operator, where there is a reasonable suspicion of a breach of this Regulation and where such records may be relevant to an investigation into breaches of this Regulation; and (e) issue public notices, including public statements indicating the identity of the natural or legal person and the nature of the breach.",
      "outbound_relations": [
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art50-Para4__article-Art50-Para1__depends_on",
          "source": "article-Art50-Para4",
          "target": "article-Art50-Para1",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "depends_on",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "Article 50(4) supplies the minimum access, investigation, inspection, summons and interview powers through which competent authorities discharge Article 50(1)'s foundational duty to possess all necessary supervisory, investigatory and sanctioning powers.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art50-Para4",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art50-Para1"
        }
      ],
      "inbound_relations": [
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art50-Para5__article-Art50-Para4__qualifies",
          "source": "article-Art50-Para5",
          "target": "article-Art50-Para4",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "qualifies",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "For legal-person breaches, article-Art50-Para5 qualifies the penalties and measures in article-Art50-Para4 by allowing their application to responsible natural persons under national law.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art50-Para5",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art50-Para4"
        },
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art51-Para1__article-Art50-Para4__references",
          "source": "article-Art51-Para1",
          "target": "article-Art50-Para4",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "references",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "article-Art51-Para1 specifies the national procedural modes for exercising administrative-penalty and remedial powers, whose concrete minimum measures are set out in article-Art50-Para4.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art51-Para1",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art50-Para4"
        },
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art51-Para2__article-Art50-Para4__qualifies",
          "source": "article-Art51-Para2",
          "target": "article-Art50-Para4",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "qualifies",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "article-Art51-Para2 qualifies use of the penalties and remedial measures in article-Art50-Para4 by requiring competent authorities to weigh gravity, responsibility, financial strength, benefit, harm and cooperation.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art51-Para2",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art50-Para4"
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_source_paragraphs": [
        {
          "sequence": 1,
          "text": "Member States shall confer on competent authorities the power to apply at least the following administrative penalties or remedial measures for breaches of this Regulation:",
          "source_line_start": 8302,
          "source_line_end": 8302
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_article_type_uri": "http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/resource-type/ART",
      "canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art50-Para4",
      "text_sha256": "e29a63e27e3fcd9780c8899124b71bb27a3662bf1c70dfc04068817b682f8fb4"
    },
    {
      "id": "article-Art50-Para5",
      "type": "article_paragraph",
      "article_number": 50,
      "paragraph_number": "5",

      "akn4eu_heading": "Administrative penalties and remedial measures",
      "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER VII"
      ],
      "text": "Where paragraph 2, point (c), and paragraph 4 apply to legal persons, Member States shall confer on competent authorities the power to apply the administrative penalties and remedial measures, subject to the conditions provided for in national law, to members of the management body, and to other individuals who under national law are responsible for the breach.",

          "relation": "qualifies",

          "reasoning": "article-Art50-Para5 qualifies the corrective powers in article-Art50-Para2 point (c) by extending their possible application to responsible management-body members and other responsible individuals.",

          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art50-Para2"
        },
        {
