          "source": "article-Art50-Para5",
          "target": "article-Art50-Para4",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "qualifies",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "For legal-person breaches, article-Art50-Para5 qualifies the penalties and measures in article-Art50-Para4 by allowing their application to responsible natural persons under national law.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art50-Para5",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art50-Para4"
        }
      ],
      "inbound_relations": [],
      "akn4eu_source_paragraphs": [
        {
          "sequence": 1,
          "text": "Where paragraph 2, point (c), and paragraph 4 apply to legal persons, Member States shall confer on competent authorities the power to apply the administrative penalties and remedial measures, subject to the conditions provided for in national law, to members of the management body, and to other individuals who under national law are responsible for the breach.",
          "source_line_start": 8375,
          "source_line_end": 8375
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_article_type_uri": "http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/resource-type/ART",
      "canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art50-Para5",
      "text_sha256": "fc2f2bc18152eb9ee334ca67bae20b5048f8852a72f99cfd6eaa893382c4a26b"
    },
    {
      "id": "article-Art50-Para6",
      "type": "article_paragraph",
      "article_number": 50,
      "paragraph_number": "6",
      "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
      "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
      "akn4eu_heading": "Administrative penalties and remedial measures",
      "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER VII"
      ],
      "text": "Member States shall ensure that any decision imposing administrative penalties or remedial measures set out in paragraph 2, point (c), is properly reasoned and is subject to a right of appeal.",
      "outbound_relations": [
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art50-Para6__article-Art50-Para2__depends_on",
          "source": "article-Art50-Para6",
          "target": "article-Art50-Para2",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "depends_on",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "The reason-giving and appeal safeguards in article-Art50-Para6 attach expressly to remedial decisions imposed under article-Art50-Para2 point (c).",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art50-Para6",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art50-Para2"
        }
      ],
      "inbound_relations": [],
      "akn4eu_source_paragraphs": [
        {
          "sequence": 1,
          "text": "Member States shall ensure that any decision imposing administrative penalties or remedial measures set out in paragraph 2, point (c), is properly reasoned and is subject to a right of appeal.",
          "source_line_start": 8378,
          "source_line_end": 8378
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_article_type_uri": "http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/resource-type/ART",
      "canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art50-Para6",
      "text_sha256": "03550e732af0ef4a6208279a6d9619cc31596e70ee38c7a4238a983f7c5fd77b"
    },
    {
      "id": "article-Art51-Para1",
      "type": "article_paragraph",
      "article_number": 51,
      "paragraph_number": "1",
      "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
      "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
      "akn4eu_heading": "Exercise of the power to impose administrative penalties and remedial measures",
      "akn4eu_sub_units": [
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(a)",
          "text": "directly;",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(a)",
          "source_line_start": 8394,
          "source_line_end": 8397
        },
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(b)",
          "text": "in collaboration with other authorities;",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(b)",
          "source_line_start": 8408,
          "source_line_end": 8411
        },
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(c)",
          "text": "under their responsibility by delegation to other authorities; or",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(c)",
          "source_line_start": 8422,
          "source_line_end": 8425
        },
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(d)",
          "text": "by application to the competent judicial authorities.",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(d)",
          "source_line_start": 8436,
          "source_line_end": 8439
        }
      ],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER VII"
      ],
      "text": "Competent authorities shall exercise the powers to impose administrative penalties and remedial measures referred to in Article 50 in accordance with their national legal frameworks, where appropriate, as follows: (a) directly; (b) in collaboration with other authorities; (c) under their responsibility by delegation to other authorities; or (d) by application to the competent judicial authorities.",
      "outbound_relations": [
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art51-Para1__article-Art50-Para4__references",
          "source": "article-Art51-Para1",
          "target": "article-Art50-Para4",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "references",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "article-Art51-Para1 specifies the national procedural modes for exercising administrative-penalty and remedial powers, whose concrete minimum measures are set out in article-Art50-Para4.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art51-Para1",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art50-Para4"
        }
      ],
      "inbound_relations": [],
      "akn4eu_source_paragraphs": [
        {
          "sequence": 1,
          "text": "Competent authorities shall exercise the powers to impose administrative penalties and remedial measures referred to in Article 50 in accordance with their national legal frameworks, where appropriate, as follows:",
          "source_line_start": 8387,
          "source_line_end": 8387
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_article_type_uri": "http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/resource-type/ART",
      "canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art51-Para1",
      "text_sha256": "0cda03fb73a88077497be01a6966656ec17e4712e4ab18469efcbd1b8d1978ab"
    },
    {
      "id": "article-Art51-Para2",
      "type": "article_paragraph",
      "article_number": 51,
      "paragraph_number": "2",
      "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
      "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
      "akn4eu_heading": "Exercise of the power to impose administrative penalties and remedial measures",
      "akn4eu_sub_units": [
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(a)",
          "text": "the materiality, gravity and the duration of the breach;",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(a)",
          "source_line_start": 8453,
          "source_line_end": 8456
        },
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(b)",
          "text": "the degree of responsibility of the natural or legal person responsible for the breach;",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(b)",
          "source_line_start": 8467,
          "source_line_end": 8470
        },
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(c)",
          "text": "the financial strength of the responsible natural or legal person;",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(c)",
          "source_line_start": 8481,
          "source_line_end": 8484
        },
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(d)",
          "text": "the importance of profits gained or losses avoided by the responsible natural or legal person, insofar as they can be determined;",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(d)",
          "source_line_start": 8495,
          "source_line_end": 8498
        },
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(e)",
          "text": "the losses for third parties caused by the breach, insofar as they can be determined;",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(e)",
          "source_line_start": 8509,
          "source_line_end": 8512
        },
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(f)",
          "text": "the level of cooperation of the responsible natural or legal person with the competent authority, without prejudice to the need to ensure disgorgement of profits gained or losses avoided by that natural or legal person;",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(f)",
          "source_line_start": 8523,
          "source_line_end": 8526
        },
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(g)",
          "text": "previous breaches by the responsible natural or legal person.",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(g)",
          "source_line_start": 8537,
          "source_line_end": 8540
        }
      ],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER VII"
      ],
      "text": "Competent authorities, when determining the type and level of an administrative penalty or remedial measure to be imposed under Article 50, shall take into account the extent to which the breach is intentional or results from negligence, and all other relevant circumstances, including the following, where appropriate: (a) the materiality, gravity and the duration of the breach; (b) the degree of responsibility of the natural or legal person responsible for the breach; (c) the financial strength of the responsible natural or legal person; (d) the importance of profits gained or losses avoided by the responsible natural or legal person, insofar as they can be determined; (e) the losses for third parties caused by the breach, insofar as they can be determined; (f) the level of cooperation of the responsible natural or legal person with the competent authority, without prejudice to the need to ensure disgorgement of profits gained or losses avoided by that natural or legal person; (g) previous breaches by the responsible natural or legal person.",
      "outbound_relations": [
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art51-Para2__article-Art50-Para4__qualifies",
          "source": "article-Art51-Para2",
          "target": "article-Art50-Para4",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "qualifies",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "article-Art51-Para2 qualifies use of the penalties and remedial measures in article-Art50-Para4 by requiring competent authorities to weigh gravity, responsibility, financial strength, benefit, harm and cooperation.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art51-Para2",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art50-Para4"
        }
      ],
      "inbound_relations": [],
      "akn4eu_source_paragraphs": [
        {
          "sequence": 1,
          "text": "Competent authorities, when determining the type and level of an administrative penalty or remedial measure to be imposed under Article 50, shall take into account the extent to which the breach is intentional or results from negligence, and all other relevant circumstances, including the following, where appropriate:",
          "source_line_start": 8446,
          "source_line_end": 8446
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_article_type_uri": "http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/resource-type/ART",
      "canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art51-Para2",
      "text_sha256": "056ae7652fb7315ffdf56de60fd449c35c028056c4bd14e2b69ef7d76bf0af6a"
    },
    {
      "id": "article-Art52-Para1",
      "type": "article_paragraph",
      "article_number": 52,
      "paragraph_number": "1",
      "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
      "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
      "akn4eu_heading": "Criminal penalties",
      "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER VII"
      ],
      "text": "Member States may decide not to lay down rules for administrative penalties or remedial measures for breaches that are subject to criminal penalties under their national law.",
      "outbound_relations": [],
      "inbound_relations": [
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art50-Para3__article-Art52-Para1__references",
          "source": "article-Art50-Para3",
          "target": "article-Art52-Para1",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "references",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "The administrative-penalty duty in article-Art50-Para3 expressly preserves the Member-State option in article-Art52-Para1 where breaches are subject to national criminal penalties.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art50-Para3",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art52-Para1"
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_source_paragraphs": [
        {
          "sequence": 1,
          "text": "Member States may decide not to lay down rules for administrative penalties or remedial measures for breaches that are subject to criminal penalties under their national law.",
          "source_line_start": 8553,
          "source_line_end": 8553
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_article_type_uri": "http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/resource-type/ART",
      "canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art52-Para1",
      "text_sha256": "df8830fb169d728813f24804b0adf0dca3a1635661d9ab3598f0def66919af58"
    },
    {
      "id": "article-Art52-Para2",
      "type": "article_paragraph",
      "article_number": 52,
      "paragraph_number": "2",
      "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
      "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
      "akn4eu_heading": "Criminal penalties",
      "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER VII"
      ],
      "text": "Where Member States have chosen to lay down criminal penalties for breaches of this Regulation, they shall ensure that appropriate measures are in place so that competent authorities have all the necessary powers to liaise with judicial, prosecuting, or criminal justice authorities within their jurisdiction to receive specific information related to criminal investigations or proceedings commenced for breaches of this Regulation, and to provide the same information to other competent authorities, as well as EBA, ESMA or EIOPA to fulfil their obligations to cooperate for the purposes of this Regulation.",
      "outbound_relations": [],
      "inbound_relations": [],
      "akn4eu_source_paragraphs": [
        {
          "sequence": 1,
          "text": "Where Member States have chosen to lay down criminal penalties for breaches of this Regulation, they shall ensure that appropriate measures are in place so that competent authorities have all the necessary powers to liaise with judicial, prosecuting, or criminal justice authorities within their jurisdiction to receive specific information related to criminal investigations or proceedings commenced for breaches of this Regulation, and to provide the same information to other competent authorities, as well as EBA, ESMA or EIOPA to fulfil their obligations to cooperate for the purposes of this Regulation.",
          "source_line_start": 8556,
          "source_line_end": 8556
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_article_type_uri": "http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/resource-type/ART",
      "canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art52-Para2",
      "text_sha256": "1ef6cca1dfb39c7afb07f856cc57201a73cad740aa793d6240d23700bedc255c"
    },
    {
      "id": "article-Art53-Para1",
      "type": "article_paragraph",
      "article_number": 53,
      "paragraph_number": "1",
      "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "single",
      "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
      "akn4eu_heading": "Notification duties",
      "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER VII"
      ],
      "text": "Member States shall notify the laws, regulations and administrative provisions implementing this Chapter, including any relevant criminal law provisions, to the Commission, ESMA, the EBA and EIOPA by 17 January 2025. Member States shall notify the Commission, ESMA, the EBA and EIOPA without undue delay of any subsequent amendments thereto.",
      "outbound_relations": [],
      "inbound_relations": [],
      "akn4eu_source_paragraphs": [
        {
          "sequence": 1,
          "text": "Member States shall notify the laws, regulations and administrative provisions implementing this Chapter, including any relevant criminal law provisions, to the Commission, ESMA, the EBA and EIOPA by 17 January 2025. Member States shall notify the Commission, ESMA, the EBA and EIOPA without undue delay of any subsequent amendments thereto.",
          "source_line_start": 8564,
          "source_line_end": 8564
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_article_type_uri": "http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/resource-type/ART",
      "canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art53-Para1",
      "text_sha256": "99a119eb7699b0e46c260e2ca724ca2b4d83924a646a5f07625e2aa2065a72e8"
    },
    {
      "id": "article-Art54-Para1",
      "type": "article_paragraph",
      "article_number": 54,
      "paragraph_number": "1",
      "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
      "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
      "akn4eu_heading": "Publication of administrative penalties",
      "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER VII"
      ],
      "text": "Competent authorities shall publish on their official websites, without undue delay, any decision imposing an administrative penalty against which there is no appeal after the addressee of the penalty has been notified of that decision.",
      "outbound_relations": [],
      "inbound_relations": [
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art54-Para2__article-Art54-Para1__depends_on",
          "source": "article-Art54-Para2",
          "target": "article-Art54-Para1",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "depends_on",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "The mandatory publication content in article-Art54-Para2 depends expressly on the final administrative-penalty decision publication required by article-Art54-Para1.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art54-Para2",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art54-Para1"
        },
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art54-Para3__article-Art54-Para1__qualifies",
          "source": "article-Art54-Para3",
          "target": "article-Art54-Para1",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "qualifies",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "article-Art54-Para3 qualifies the publication duty in article-Art54-Para1 by permitting deferral, anonymity or non-publication after a case-specific proportionality and market-stability assessment.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art54-Para3",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art54-Para1"
        },
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art54-Para5__article-Art54-Para1__qualifies",
          "source": "article-Art54-Para5",
          "target": "article-Art54-Para1",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "qualifies",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "article-Art54-Para5 qualifies the no-appeal publication trigger in article-Art54-Para1 by prescribing additional website notices when an appeal is pending and when a judicial decision annuls the penalty.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art54-Para5",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art54-Para1"
        },
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art54-Para6__article-Art54-Para1__qualifies",
          "source": "article-Art54-Para6",
          "target": "article-Art54-Para1",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "qualifies",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "The website-retention ceiling in article-Art54-Para6 qualifies publications made under article-Art54-Para1 by limiting them to necessity and no more than five years.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art54-Para6",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art54-Para1"
        },
        {
          "edge_id": "recital-97__article-Art54-Para1__concretizes",
          "source": "recital-97",
          "target": "article-Art54-Para1",
          "source_type": "recital",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "concretizes",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "recital-97's transparency requirement for administrative penalties is implemented by the official-website publication duty in article-Art54-Para1.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/recital-97",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art54-Para1"
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_source_paragraphs": [
        {
          "sequence": 1,
          "text": "Competent authorities shall publish on their official websites, without undue delay, any decision imposing an administrative penalty against which there is no appeal after the addressee of the penalty has been notified of that decision.",
          "source_line_start": 8572,
          "source_line_end": 8572
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_article_type_uri": "http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/resource-type/ART",
      "canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art54-Para1",
      "text_sha256": "5ee84bed69a4c1ec50a5de64d0615d346f3950b4ac11bb40abbd85d6fb66c4c8"
    },
    {
      "id": "article-Art54-Para2",
      "type": "article_paragraph",
      "article_number": 54,
      "paragraph_number": "2",
      "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
      "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
      "akn4eu_heading": "Publication of administrative penalties",
      "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER VII"
      ],
      "text": "The publication referred to in paragraph 1 shall include information on the type and nature of the breach, the identity of the persons responsible and the penalties imposed.",
      "outbound_relations": [
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art54-Para2__article-Art54-Para1__depends_on",
          "source": "article-Art54-Para2",
          "target": "article-Art54-Para1",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "depends_on",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "The mandatory publication content in article-Art54-Para2 depends expressly on the final administrative-penalty decision publication required by article-Art54-Para1.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art54-Para2",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art54-Para1"
        }
      ],
      "inbound_relations": [
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art54-Para6__article-Art54-Para2__qualifies",
          "source": "article-Art54-Para6",
          "target": "article-Art54-Para2",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "qualifies",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "Publication-content information required by article-Art54-Para2 remains online only within the necessity and five-year limit imposed by article-Art54-Para6.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art54-Para6",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art54-Para2"
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_source_paragraphs": [
        {
          "sequence": 1,
          "text": "The publication referred to in paragraph 1 shall include information on the type and nature of the breach, the identity of the persons responsible and the penalties imposed.",
          "source_line_start": 8575,
          "source_line_end": 8575
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_article_type_uri": "http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/resource-type/ART",
      "canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art54-Para2",
      "text_sha256": "6b767c34cdc259abd0b4056cf2d3420f49e2b9fc62ae7cbad43fe83959ecf50f"
    },
    {
      "id": "article-Art54-Para3",
      "type": "article_paragraph",
      "article_number": 54,
      "paragraph_number": "3",
      "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
      "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
      "akn4eu_heading": "Publication of administrative penalties",
      "akn4eu_sub_units": [
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(a)",
          "text": "defer its publication until all reasons for non-publication cease to exist;",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(a)",
          "source_line_start": 8585,
          "source_line_end": 8588
        },
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(b)",
          "text": "publish it on an anonymous basis, in accordance with national law; or",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(b)",
          "source_line_start": 8599,
          "source_line_end": 8602
        },
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(c)",
          "text": "refrain from publishing it, where the options set out in points (a) and (b) are deemed either insufficient to guarantee a lack of any danger for the stability of financial markets, or where such a publication would not be proportionate to the leniency of the imposed penalty.",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(c)",
          "source_line_start": 8613,
          "source_line_end": 8616
        }
      ],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER VII"
      ],
      "text": "Where the competent authority, following a case-by-case assessment, considers that the publication of the identity, in the case of legal persons, or of the identity and personal data, in the case of natural persons, would be disproportionate, including risks in relation to the protection of personal data, jeopardise the stability of financial markets or the pursuit of an ongoing criminal investigation, or cause, insofar as these can be determined, disproportionate damages to the person involved, it shall adopt one of the following solutions in respect of the decision imposing an administrative penalty: (a) defer its publication until all reasons for non-publication cease to exist; (b) publish it on an anonymous basis, in accordance with national law; or (c) refrain from publishing it, where the options set out in points (a) and (b) are deemed either insufficient to guarantee a lack of any danger for the stability of financial markets, or where such a publication would not be proportionate to the leniency of the imposed penalty.",
      "outbound_relations": [
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art54-Para3__article-Art54-Para1__qualifies",
          "source": "article-Art54-Para3",
          "target": "article-Art54-Para1",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "qualifies",
          "confidence": "high",

          "text": "Where the competent authority, following a case-by-case assessment, considers that the publication of the identity, in the case of legal persons, or of the identity and personal data, in the case of natural persons, would be disproportionate, including risks in relation to the protection of personal data, jeopardise the stability of financial markets or the pursuit of an ongoing criminal investigation, or cause, insofar as these can be determined, disproportionate damages to the person involved, it shall adopt one of the following solutions in respect of the decision imposing an administrative penalty:",

    {

      "text": "Any confidential information received, exchanged or transmitted pursuant to this Regulation shall be subject to the conditions of professional secrecy laid down in paragraph 2.",

          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art55-Para2"

    {

        "CHAPTER VII"
      ],
      "text": "The obligation of professional secrecy applies to all persons who work, or who have worked, for the competent authorities pursuant to this Regulation, or for any authority or market undertaking or natural or legal person to whom those competent authorities have delegated their powers, including auditors and experts contracted by them.",

          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art55-Para2"
        }

    {

      "type": "article_paragraph",

        "CHAPTER VII"
      ],
      "text": "Information covered by professional secrecy, including the exchange of information among competent authorities under this Regulation and competent authorities designated or established in accordance with Directive (EU) 2022/2555, shall not be disclosed to any other person or authority except by virtue of provisions laid down by Union or national law;",
      "outbound_relations": [

          "relation": "depends_on",

          "reasoning": "Article 55(3) operates on information covered by the professional-secrecy regime established in Article 55(1) and gives that regime substantive effect through a prohibition on disclosure absent a Union- or national-law basis.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art55-Para3",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art55-Para1"
        }
      ],
      "inbound_relations": [

          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "qualifies",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "Article 55(4) qualifies Article 55(3)'s non-disclosure rule for exchanged business, operational, economic and personal information by permitting disclosure when authorised at communication or necessary for legal proceedings.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art55-Para4",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art55-Para3"

      "akn4eu_source_paragraphs": [

      "akn4eu_article_type_uri": "http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/resource-type/ART",

        "CHAPTER VII"
      ],
      "text": "All information exchanged between the competent authorities pursuant to this Regulation that concerns business or operational conditions and other economic or personal affairs shall be considered confidential and shall be subject to the requirements of professional secrecy, except where the competent authority states, at the time of communication, that such information may be disclosed or where such disclosure is necessary for legal proceedings.",

          "relation": "qualifies",

          "reasoning": "Article 55(4) qualifies Article 55(3)'s non-disclosure rule for exchanged business, operational, economic and personal information by permitting disclosure when authorised at communication or necessary for legal proceedings.",

          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art55-Para3"
        }

      "text": "The ESAs and the competent authorities shall be allowed to process personal data only where necessary for the purpose of carrying out their respective obligations and duties pursuant to this Regulation, in particular for investigation, inspection, request for information, communication, publication, evaluation, verification, assessment and drafting of oversight plans.     {
      "id": "article-Art57-Para2",
      "type": "article_paragraph",
      "article_number": 57,
      "paragraph_number": "2",

      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER VIII"
      ],
      "text": "The power to adopt delegated acts referred to in Articles 31(6) and 43(2) shall be conferred on the Commission for a period of five years from 17 January 2024. The Commission shall draw up a report in respect of the delegation of power not later than nine months before the end of the five-year period. The delegation of power shall be tacitly extended for periods of an identical duration, unless the European Parliament or the Council opposes such extension not later than three months before the end of each period.",
      "outbound_relations": [
        {

          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "references",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "article-Art57-Para2 expressly sets the five-year duration and extension mechanism for the criticality-criteria delegation conferred by article-Art31-Para6.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art57-Para2",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art31-Para6"
        },
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art57-Para2__article-Art43-Para2__references",
          "source": "article-Art57-Para2",
          "target": "article-Art43-Para2",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "references",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "The same delegation-duration rule in article-Art57-Para2 expressly governs the fee-setting delegated act authorised by article-Art43-Para2.",

          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art43-Para2"
        },
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art57-Para2__article-Art57-Para1__qualifies",
          "source": "article-Art57-Para2",
          "target": "article-Art57-Para1",

          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "qualifies",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "Article 57(2) qualifies the Commission delegation conferred in Article 57(1) by fixing its initial five-year duration, report deadline, tacit extensions and the Parliament-or-Council opposition condition for extension.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art57-Para2",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art57-Para1"
        }
      ],
      "inbound_relations": [

          "reasoning": "article-Art31-Para6 -> article-Art57-Para2: Article 31(6) invokes Article 57's delegation procedure, and Article 57(2) is the narrow paragraph that expressly fixes the duration of the power conferred by Article 31(6).",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art31-Para6",

          "relation": "depends_on",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "The fee-setting delegated act in article-Art43-Para2 is subject to Article 57, and article-Art57-Para2 is the narrow provision specifically governing the duration of that delegation.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art43-Para2",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art57-Para2"
        }

The delegation of power shall be tacitly extended for periods of an identical duration, unless the European Parliament or the Council opposes such extension not later than three months before the end of each period.",
          "source_line_start": 8683,

    {
      "id": "article-Art57-Para3",
      "type": "article_paragraph",
      "article_number": 57,
      "paragraph_number": "3",
      "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
      "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
      "akn4eu_heading": "Exercise of the delegation",
      "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER VIII"
      ],
      "text": "The delegation of power referred to in Articles 31(6) and 43(2) may be revoked at any time by the European Parliament or by the Council. A decision to revoke shall put an end to the delegation of the power specified in that decision. It shall take effect the day following the publication of the decision in the Official Journal of the European Union or at a later date specified therein. It shall not affect the validity of any delegated acts already in force.",
      "outbound_relations": [
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art57-Para3__article-Art31-Para6__references",
          "source": "article-Art57-Para3",
          "target": "article-Art31-Para6",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "references",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "article-Art57-Para3 expressly makes the criticality-criteria delegation in article-Art31-Para6 revocable by the European Parliament or Council.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art57-Para3",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art31-Para6"
        },
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art57-Para3__article-Art43-Para2__references",
          "source": "article-Art57-Para3",
          "target": "article-Art43-Para2",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "references",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "The revocation mechanism in article-Art57-Para3 expressly also applies to the oversight-fee delegation in article-Art43-Para2.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art57-Para3",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art43-Para2"
        },
        {

          "target": "article-Art57-Para1",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "qualifies",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "Article 57(3) qualifies the delegated power conferred in Article 57(1) by making it revocable at any time by the European Parliament or the Council and regulating the effect of revocation.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art57-Para3",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art57-Para1"
        }
      ],
      "inbound_relations": [],

    {
      "id": "article-Art57-Para4",
      "type": "article_paragraph",
      "article_number": 57,
      "paragraph_number": "4",

      "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER VIII"
      ],
      "text": "Before adopting a delegated act, the Commission shall consult experts designated by each Member State in accordance with the principles laid down in the Interinstitutional Agreement of 13 April 2016 on Better Law-Making.",
      "outbound_relations": [
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art57-Para4__article-Art57-Para1__qualifies",
          "source": "article-Art57-Para4",
          "target": "article-Art57-Para1",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "qualifies",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "Article 57(4) qualifies exercise of the delegated power conferred in Article 57(1) by requiring consultation of Member-State experts under the Better Law-Making Agreement before any delegated act is adopted.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art57-Para4",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art57-Para1"
        }
      ],
      "inbound_relations": [
        {
          "edge_id": "recital-98__article-Art57-Para4__concretizes",
          "source": "recital-98",
          "target": "article-Art57-Para4",
          "source_type": "recital",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "concretizes",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "The Member-State expert consultation safeguard emphasised by recital-98 is required before adoption of delegated acts under article-Art57-Para4.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/recital-98",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art57-Para4"
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_source_paragraphs": [

        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_article_type_uri": "http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/resource-type/ART",

    {
      "id": "article-Art57-Para5",
      "type": "article_paragraph",
      "article_number": 57,
      "paragraph_number": "5",
      "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
      "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
      "akn4eu_heading": "Exercise of the delegation",
      "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER VIII"
      ],
      "text": "As soon as it adopts a delegated act, the Commission shall notify it simultaneously to the European Parliament and to the Council.",
      "outbound_relations": [
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art57-Para5__article-Art57-Para1__depends_on",
          "source": "article-Art57-Para5",
          "target": "article-Art57-Para1",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "depends_on",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "Article 57(5)'s simultaneous notification duty arises only when the Commission exercises the delegated-act power conferred by Article 57(1), making the notification procedure operationally dependent on that delegation.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art57-Para5",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art57-Para1"
        }
      ],
      "inbound_relations": [],
      "akn4eu_source_paragraphs": [
        {
          "sequence": 1,
          "text": "As soon as it adopts a delegated act, the Commission shall notify it simultaneously to the European Parliament and to the Council.",
          "source_line_start": 8692,
          "source_line_end": 8692
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_article_type_uri": "http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/resource-type/ART",
      "canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art57-Para5",
      "text_sha256": "288f2f93767bec3e20501a22d3b326e8dd0761eee3351ecdb147910cd64664d6"
    },
    {
      "id": "article-Art57-Para6",
      "type": "article_paragraph",
      "article_number": 57,
      "paragraph_number": "6",
      "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
      "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
      "akn4eu_heading": "Exercise of the delegation",
      "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER VIII"
      ],
      "text": "A delegated act adopted pursuant to Articles 31(6) and 43(2) shall enter into force only if no objection has been expressed either by the European Parliament or by the Council within a period of three months of notification of that act to the European Parliament and the Council or if, before the expiry of that period, the European Parliament and the Council have both informed the Commission that they will not object. That period shall be extended by three months at the initiative of the European Parliament or of the Council.",
      "outbound_relations": [
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art57-Para6__article-Art31-Para6__references",
          "source": "article-Art57-Para6",
          "target": "article-Art31-Para6",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "references",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "The parliamentary and Council no-objection condition in article-Art57-Para6 expressly governs entry into force of delegated acts adopted under article-Art31-Para6.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art57-Para6",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art31-Para6"
        },
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art57-Para6__article-Art43-Para2__references",
          "source": "article-Art57-Para6",
          "target": "article-Art43-Para2",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "references",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "article-Art57-Para6 expressly subjects delegated fee acts adopted under article-Art43-Para2 to the three-month parliamentary and Council objection period.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art57-Para6",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art43-Para2"
        },
        {
          "edge_id": "article-Art57-Para6__article-Art57-Para1__qualifies",
          "source": "article-Art57-Para6",
          "target": "article-Art57-Para1",
          "source_type": "article_paragraph",
          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "qualifies",
          "confidence": "high",
          "reasoning": "Article 57(6) qualifies the delegated power conferred in Article 57(1) by withholding entry into force where Parliament or Council objects within the specified period and by regulating extension of that scrutiny period.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art57-Para6",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art57-Para1"
        }
      ],
      "inbound_relations": [],
      "akn4eu_source_paragraphs": [
        {
          "sequence": 1,
          "text": "A delegated act adopted pursuant to Articles 31(6) and 43(2) shall enter into force only if no objection has been expressed either by the European Parliament or by the Council within a period of three months of notification of that act to the European Parliament and the Council or if, before the expiry of that period, the European Parliament and the Council have both informed the Commission that they will not object. That period shall be extended by three months at the initiative of the European Parliament or of the Council.",
          "source_line_start": 8695,
          "source_line_end": 8695
        }
      ],
      "akn4eu_article_type_uri": "http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/resource-type/ART",
      "canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art57-Para6",
      "text_sha256": "d05eb616b3829bff0441f316cca7e8f59e7da325c4d7abdcbd9537bf8c93da76"
    },
    {
      "id": "article-Art58-Para1",
      "type": "article_paragraph",
      "article_number": 58,
      "paragraph_number": "1",
      "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
      "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
      "akn4eu_heading": "Review clause",
      "akn4eu_sub_units": [
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(a)",
          "text": "the criteria for the designation of critical ICT third-party service providers in accordance with Article 31(2);",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(a)",
          "source_line_start": 8727,
          "source_line_end": 8730
        },
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(b)",
          "text": "the voluntary nature of the notification of significant cyber threats referred to in Article 19;",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(b)",
          "source_line_start": 8741,
          "source_line_end": 8744
        },
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(c)",
          "text": "the regime referred to in Article 31(12) and the powers of the Lead Overseer provided for in Article 35(1), point (d), point (iv), first indent, with a view to evaluating the effectiveness of those provisions with regard to ensuring effective oversight of critical ICT third-party service providers established in a third country, and the necessity to establish a subsidiary in the Union. For the purposes of the first subparagraph of this point, the review shall include an analysis of the regime referred to in Article 31(12), including in terms of access for Union financial entities to services from third countries and availability of such services on the Union market and it shall take into account further developments in the markets for the services covered by this Regulation, the practical experience of financial entities and financial supervisors with regard to the application and, respectively, supervision of that regime, and any relevant regulatory and supervisory developments taking place at international level.",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(c)",
          "source_line_start": 8755,
          "source_line_end": 8759
        },
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(d)",
          "text": "the appropriateness of including in the scope of this Regulation financial entities referred to in Article 2(3), point (e), making use of automated sales systems, in light of future market developments on the use of such systems;",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(d)",
          "source_line_start": 8770,
          "source_line_end": 8773
        },
        {
          "type": "point",
          "marker": "(e)",
          "text": "the functioning and effectiveness of the JON in supporting the consistency of the oversight and the efficiency of the exchange of information within the Oversight Framework.",
          "depth": 1,
          "parent_marker": null,
          "path": "(e)",
          "source_line_start": 8784,
          "source_line_end": 8787
        }
      ],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER IX",
        "Section I"
      ],
      "text": "By 17 January 2028, the Commission shall, after consulting the ESAs and the ESRB, as appropriate, carry out a review and submit a report to the European Parliament and the Council, accompanied, where appropriate, by a legislative proposal. The review shall include at least the following: (a) the criteria for the designation of critical ICT third-party service providers in accordance with Article 31(2); (b) the voluntary nature of the notification of significant cyber threats referred to in Article 19; (c) the regime referred to in Article 31(12) and the powers of the Lead Overseer provided for in Article 35(1), point (d), point (iv), first indent, with a view to evaluating the effectiveness of those provisions with regard to ensuring effective oversight of critical ICT third-party service providers established in a third country, and the necessity to establish a subsidiary in the Union. For the purposes of the first subparagraph of this point, the review shall include an analysis of the regime referred to in Article 31(12), including in terms of access for Union financial entities to services from third countries and availability of such services on the Union market and it shall take into account further developments in the markets for the services covered by this Regulation, the practical experience of financial entities and financial supervisors with regard to the application and, respectively, supervision of that regime, and any relevant regulatory and supervisory developments taking place at international level. (d) the appropriateness of including in the scope of this Regulation financial entities referred to in Article 2(3), point (e), making use of automated sales systems, in light of future market developments on the use of such systems; (e) the functioning and effectiveness of the JON in supporting the consistency of the oversight and the efficiency of the exchange of information within the Oversight Framework.",

    {
      "id": "article-Art58-Para2",
      "type": "article_paragraph",
      "article_number": 58,

      "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
      "ancestry": [
        "CHAPTER IX",
        "Section I"
      ],
      "text": "In the context of the review of Directive (EU) 2015/2366, the Commission shall assess the need for increased cyber resilience of payment systems and payment-processing activities and the appropriateness of extending the scope of this Regulation to operators of payment systems and entities involved in payment-processing activities. In light of this assessment, the Commission shall submit, as part of the review of Directive (EU) 2015/2366, a report to the European Parliament and the Council no later than 17 July 2023. Based on that review report, and after consulting ESAs, ECB and the ESRB, the Commission may submit, where appropriate and as part of the legislative proposal that it may adopt pursuant to Article 108, second paragraph, of Directive (EU) 2015/2366, a proposal to ensure that all operators of payment systems and entities involved in payment-processing activities are subject to an appropriate oversight, while taking into account existing oversight by the central bank.",
      "outbound_relations": [],
      "inbound_relations": [

          "target_type": "article_paragraph",
          "relation": "concretizes",

          "reasoning": "recital-104 calls for an assessment of payment-system and payment-processing cyber resilience within the PSD2 review; article-Art58-Para2 prescribes that assessment, report and possible proposal.",
          "source_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/recital-104",
          "target_canonical_ref": "celex:32022R2554/article-Art58-Para2"
        }

          "text": "In the context of the review of Directive (EU) 2015/2366, the Commission shall assess the need for increased cyber resilience of payment systems and payment-processing activities and the appropriateness of extending the scope of this Regulation to operators of payment systems and entities involved in payment-processing activities. In light of this assessment, the Commission shall submit, as part of the review of Directive (EU) 2015/2366, a report to the European Parliament and the Council no later than 17 July 2023.",

      "text": "Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 is amended as follows: (1) Article 26 is amended as follows: (a) paragraph 3 is replaced by the following: ‘3. A CCP shall maintain and operate an organisational structure that ensures continuity and orderly functioning in the performance of its services and activities. It shall employ appropriate and proportionate systems, resources and procedures, including ICT systems managed in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 of the European Parliament and of the Council ( *2 ) . (b) paragraph 6 is deleted; (2) Article 34 is amended as follows: (a) paragraph 1 is replaced by the following: ‘1. A CCP shall establish, implement and maintain an adequate business continuity policy and disaster recovery plan, which shall include ICT business continuity policy and ICT response and recovery plans put in place and implemented in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, aiming to ensure the preservation of its functions, the timely recovery of operations and the fulfilment of the CCP’s obligations.’; (b) in paragraph 3, the first subparagraph is replaced by the following: ‘3. In order to ensure consistent application of this Article, ESMA shall, after consulting the members of the ESCB, develop draft regulatory technical standards specifying the minimum content and requirements of the business continuity policy and of the disaster recovery plan, excluding ICT business continuity policy and disaster recovery plans.’; (3) in Article 56(3), the first subparagraph is replaced by the following: ‘3. In order to ensure consistent application of this Article, ESMA shall develop draft regulatory technical standards specifying the details, other than for requirements related to ICT risk management, of the application for registration referred to in paragraph 1.’; (4) in Article 79, paragraphs 1 and 2 are replaced by the following: ‘1. A trade repository shall identify sources of operational risk and minimise them also through the development of appropriate systems, controls and procedures, including ICT systems managed in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2022/2554. 2. A trade repository shall establish, implement and maintain an adequate business continuity policy and disaster recovery plan including ICT business continuity policy and ICT response and recovery plans established in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, aiming to ensure the maintenance of its functions, the timely recovery of operations and the fulfilment of the trade repository’s obligations.’; (5) in Article 80, paragraph 1 is deleted. (6) in Annex I, Section II is amended as follows: (a) points (a) and (b) are replaced by the following: ‘(a) a trade repository infringes Article 79(1) by not identifying sources of operational risk or by not minimising those risks through the development of appropriate systems, controls and procedures including ICT systems managed in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2022/2554; (b) a trade repository infringes Article 79(2) by not establishing, implementing or maintaining an adequate business continuity policy and disaster recovery plan established in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, aiming to ensure the maintenance of its functions, the timely recovery of operations and the fulfilment of the trade repository’s obligations;’; (b) point (c) is deleted. (7) Annex III is amended as follows: (a) Section II is amended as follows: (i) point (c) is replaced by the following: ‘(c) a Tier 2 CCP infringes Article 26(3) by not maintaining or operating an organisational structure that ensures continuity and orderly functioning in the performance of its services and activities or by not employing appropriate and proportionate systems, resources or procedures including ICT systems managed in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2022/2554;’; (ii) point (f) is deleted. (b) in Section III, point (a) is replaced by the following: ‘(a) a Tier 2 CCP infringes Article 34(1) by not establishing, implementing or maintaining an adequate business continuity policy and response and recovery plan set up in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, aiming to ensure the preservation of its functions, the timely recovery of operations and the fulfilment of the CCP’s obligations, which at least allows for the recovery of all transactions at the time of disruption to allow the CCP to continue to operate with certainty and to complete settlement on the scheduled date;’.",
